summary: Completed comprehensive E3 Dispatch & Komunikasi Operasi testing. All backend APIs (26/26 tests) and frontend UI flows verified successfully. RBAC working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Health check, login flow (owner/ops_admin/driver)
Backend: GET /api/dispatch/today returns correct structure with date, summary, departures
Backend: Date navigation with query parameter works correctly
Backend: POST /api/dispatch/{booking_id}/assign creates trip, assigns driver/vehicle, geocodes destination (Nominatim)
Backend: POST /api/dispatch/{booking_id}/confirm-departure sets departure_confirmed_at, triggers WA mock event
Backend: POST /api/dispatch/trips/{trip_id}/enroute updates status to 'to_pickup', sets enroute_at, triggers WA mock
Backend: POST /api/dispatch/trips/{trip_id}/arrived sets arrived_at, triggers WA mock
Backend: POST /api/dispatch/trips/{trip_id}/pod accepts recipient_name + note (photo optional), stores POD data
Backend: RBAC - driver role returns 403 for dispatch endpoints
Backend: RBAC - ops_admin role can access dispatch endpoints
Frontend: Login flow works (Masuk ERP button -> login form -> redirect to /app)
Frontend: Dispatch page loads with data-testid='dispatch-page'
Frontend: KPI summary cards display correctly (Berangkat: 2, Perlu Assign: 0, Perlu Konfirmasi: 0, Sedang Jalan: 0, Selesai: 0)
Frontend: Date navigation buttons (Hari Ini, Besok, prev/next chevrons, date input) work correctly
Frontend: Departures table renders with 2 bookings showing code, customer, route, driver/vehicle, status pills
Frontend: Action buttons present (Assign: 2, Berangkat: 1, POD: 2)
Frontend: Assign dialog opens with driver/vehicle selects and save/cancel buttons
Frontend: POD dialog opens with recipient input, note textarea, and save/cancel buttons
Frontend: RBAC - driver role does NOT see Dispatch menu in sidebar
Frontend: RBAC - driver accessing /app/dispatch directly shows 'Gagal memuat - Akses ditolak untuk modul ini'
Integration: WhatsApp mock provider working (events triggered, no real messages sent)
Integration: Geocoding via Nominatim working (Dieng -> 'Dieng, Wonosobo, Jawa Tengah, Indonesia')
Integration: Navigation icon import fixed in navigationConfig.js
Integration: Frontend deps (leaflet, photo-sphere-viewer) installed correctly
